prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.content:
Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0004",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 31,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01152-01155",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "静かに慌てた足取り……子供の頃のシュリは\nよく俺に向かって走り寄って来ていたので、\n転んで怪我をするといけないと注意した所、\nそれ以来この様な歩き方をするようになった。",
      "en": "Quiet but hurried footsteps... When Shuri was little, she used to run up to me often. I warned her she might fall and hurt herself, and she's walked like this ever since."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01161-01162",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "済みません、お待たせしてしまって……",
      "en": "I am sorry to have kept you waiting..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01168-01169",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "別にいいのよ、ね、セリカ",
      "en": "It's no problem, right, Celica?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01171-01172",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ",
      "en": "Yeah."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01174-01175",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "それで、シュリちゃんは何にするの？",
      "en": "So, what would you like, Shuri?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01181-01182",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、私は御主人様の後に頂きます",
      "en": "Ah, I'll have mine after Master."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01184-01184",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言ってシュリは俺の斜め後ろに立った。",
      "en": "Saying that, Shuri stood diagonally behind me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01190-01191",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "どうしたの、シュリちゃん？",
      "en": "What is wrong, Shuri?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01193-01193",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "リンシャが不思議そうにシュリに声を掛ける。",
      "en": "Rinsha called out to Shuri, looking puzzled."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01199-01200",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい、給仕を務めさせて頂きます",
      "en": "Yes, I shall serve as your attendant."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01206-01207",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "給仕って……",
      "en": "Serve...?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01209-01209",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "点になったリンシャの目が俺に向く。",
      "en": "Rinsha's stunned gaze turns on me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01211-01212",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "シュリ、席へ",
      "en": "Shuri, sit."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01218-01219",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "ですが御主人様……",
      "en": "But Master..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01221-01227",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "これは、いつものやりとりだ……。\nシュリは、俺と一緒に食事に出ると何時もこうして\n給仕を買って出ようとする。\n放って置くと確かに完璧に給仕を務めるのだが、\n屋敷に居る時ならまだしも、食堂などでこれをやると\n目立つ事この上ない……",
      "en": "This is our usual exchange...\nWhenever Shuri and I go out to eat,\nshe always tries to serve like this.\nLeft to her own devices, she'd do it perfectly,\nbut while it's fine at the mansion,\nin a restaurant it would stand out far too much..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01233-01236",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "そうよシュリちゃん、うちの料理は給仕に立たなきゃ\nいけないほど食べづらい物じゃ無いんだし。\nそれに御主人様一人に寂しく食事させたら可哀想でしょ",
      "en": "That's right, Shuri. Our food isn't so hard to eat that you need to stand and serve. And besides, it would be a shame to make your master eat all alone, don't you think?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01242-01243",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01245-01246",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "シュリ",
      "en": "Shuri"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01248-01249",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい、畏まりました……",
      "en": "Yes, as you wish..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01251-01253",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺に促されてシュリは漸く俺の後ろから離れ\nぎこちない動きで席に着くシュリの態度は\n不承不承という訳ではなく、寧ろ緊張した面持ちがある。",
      "en": "Urged by me, Shuri finally left my side and took her seat with awkward movements. She wasn't reluctant, but rather seemed tense."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01255-01256",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "俺はこれを",
      "en": "I'll have this."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01258-01259",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺は頬を赤く染めて俯いているシュリを見ながら、\nメニューのリンシャに教えてもらった料理を指差した。",
      "en": "As I looked at Shuri, her face flushed and gaze lowered, I pointed to the dish Rinsha had recommended on the menu."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01265-01266",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "はい、それでシュリちゃんは？",
      "en": "All right, and for you, Shuri?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01272-01273",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、では私も御主人様と同じ物を……",
      "en": "Ah, then I will have the same as Master..."
    }
  ]
}
